_note: Incarnon evolutions per weapon, hand-curated from each weapon's wiki page (no wiki data module has them). Tier I (the Incarnon form itself) is implicit. Each option: name, text (as in game), forms ('both' | 'incarnon' | 'normal'), modifiers (engine stat lines) and/or behaviour (named mechanic with tunable parameters). Options with no damage effect just have text. Incarnon magazine sizes come from the wiki weapon modules (IncarnonCharges); 'rounds' here overrides them.

options.name: Lethal Rearmament
options.text: On Headshot: +30% Reload Speed for 12s. Stacks up to 3x.

options.name: Feather of Justice
options.text: +60% Ammo Efficiency while Aim Gliding or Sliding

options.name: Elemental Excess
options.text: +20% Status Chance, -10% Critical Chance (flat, after mods)

options.name: Devouring Attrition
options.text: 50% chance to deal +2000% damage on non-critical hits (multiplicative; doesn't work on bosses)

options.name: Overwhelming Attrition
options.text: On a hit that is neither critical nor applies a status: +400% damage for 10s, stacks up to 3x (additive with damage mods; stacks decay one at a time)
